title: Edit Hindi PDF
description: Replace detected Hindi or English text, add text overlays, and export a new PDF. Core editing stays on your device.

title: Translate Hindi ↔ English
description: Translate Hindi or English text after approving secure AI processing. Review the translated text and export a new PDF.

title: Merge PDF
description: Combine multiple PDFs in your chosen order. Processing stays in your browser and creates a new file.

title: Split PDF
description: Extract selected page ranges into a new PDF. Processing stays on your device.

title: Compress PDF
description: Reduce PDF size by re-encoding pages as images. Review readability before downloading; text becomes image-based.
